newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Bimbo outlines wheat consumption levels.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Bimbo outlines wheat consumption levels.

text.p: Grupo Industrial Bimbo, Mexico's bread, cakes and cookies giant, currently consumes around 13 of the national wheat demand, Corporate President Rafael Velez Valadez said in an interview.
Velez Valadez said Mexico's annual wheat consumption was around 6.0 million tonnes.

He added that with the harvest running at an average between 3.5 million and 4.0 million tonnes, imports were needed not only to make up the deficit but also to supply Mexico's shortage of hard wheats for bread making.
He said Bimbo bought from the domestic wheat farmers and also imported wheat. He declined to give a breakdown.

Velez Valadez said volumes of imports varied, largely according to the national wheat harvest, which is capable of dropping down to 2.5 million tonnes in years of drought and touching 4.2 million tonnes in bumper years.
